domain_analysis.scope: Interior NC architectural element stain/clear for beams (LF), columns (EA), mantels (EA)
key_differences_from_trim_stain: Three paintable items with distinct UOMs (beam LF, column EA, mantel EA) — NOT aggregated like trim
QT3-QT5 range (mantels are focal-point surfaces worthy of QT5 premium treatment)
Element-specific complexity modifiers (beam_profile, column_type, mantel_type) — NOT profile_complexity
Mixed working heights: beams overhead (H2-H3), columns full-height (H1-H3), mantels wall-height (H1)
MIXED unit_of_measure in production — per-item rates for each element type
fireplace_surround protection zone unique to this spec (mask stone/brick during mantel spray)
Discrete elements, not room-spanning — localized protection
Beam stain ~50 LF/hr (wider surface per LF than trim at 80 LF/hr)
Column stain ~30-40 min/EA, mantel stain ~45-60 min/EA

key_rates.beam_stain_brush: 50 LF/hr — wider than trim, 3 exposed faces. ~72 sec/LF.
key_rates.mantel_stain_brush: ~50 min/EA — detail work on surround legs, shelf, returns

risk_notes.risk: Stain runs on overhead beam faces
risk_notes.mitigation: Brush method recommended for beams. Gel stain reduces drip. Wipe immediately.

risk_notes.risk: Mantels are high-visibility focal points — any stain/clear defect is immediately visible
risk_notes.mitigation: QT4-QT5 recommended. Extra care on inspection and touch-up. Test stain color on scrap.

risk_notes.risk: Round/fluted columns challenge even stain application around circumference
risk_notes.mitigation: Work in sections. Maintain wet edge around column. column_type modifier accounts for extra time.
